about_the_game:
The first original soundtrack for War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius is now available for download!

This album features 44 tracks, including in-game music such as 'Main Theme', 'TACTICS' and 'All for Love' — performed by vocalist Raychell.

Enjoy the rich musical landscape that brings the world of War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius to life.

※This product contains the same content as the soundtrack released on December 16, 2020. (Updated on October 27, 2025)
